population: Fictional 25+ profiles, ANES fresh combined pre-election weighted joint-cell priors, age/education matched to ACS resident benchmarks within Census region. Not a representative electorate.
support_rule: Coarsened joint region x age x education x party x race x income cells; minimum five training records per cell. Sparse cells excluded and counted, never imputed. Five-category education was infeasible with this support rule; three-category mapping frozen for exploratory pilot before model execution.
limitations: ANES citizen universe differs from ACS resident universe
Race table is all ages, income table counts households; do not force either as 25+ person marginals
No individual survey variance estimates; calibration diagnostics are descriptive
State inference unavailable from small region-stratified pilot
Cross-tabs suppressed below five contributing survey records
